# FDG5083

> DO define operator overloads in structs that represent numbers (such as `System.Decimal`).

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.7 Operator Overloads.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not checked: whether a struct represents a number is a design judgment. A type that implements the generic math interfaces (INumber&lt;T> and others) must already declare their operators, which the compiler enforces.
